description: Partie 3 — examen blanc n°2 : 13 conversations (dont 2 à trois locuteurs, 3 avec graphique, 2 questions de sens implicite).

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Good morning. I think I left my employee badge at home, and I can't get through the gate.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: No problem. I can issue you a temporary pass for today. May I see a photo ID?

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Here's my driver's license.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Rossi. This pass will work until six P.M. Please return it to this desk before you leave.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Will it open the parking garage too? I drove in today.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: I'm afraid not. You'll need to use the visitors' entrance on Elm Street.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Jenna, the coffee machine in the break room is leaking again. That's the third time this month.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: I know. I've already asked facilities to repair it twice. Maybe it's time to replace it.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: I agree. I saw an advertisement for a new model that makes twelve cups at once, and it isn't too expensive.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Send me the link, and I'll include it in my budget request. The deadline for equipment purchases is next Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: I'll e-mail it to you right now.

transcript.speaker: Woman 1
transcript.text: Let's look at the results of the spring campaign. Tom, how did the online videos do?

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Really well, actually. They were viewed over two hundred thousand times, which is double what we expected.

transcript.speaker: Woman 2
transcript.text: But sales in our stores didn't increase much. Most of the growth came from our website.

transcript.speaker: Woman 1
transcript.text: Interesting. So people watched the videos and went straight online to buy.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Exactly. That's why I think we should add a discount code to the next videos. That way we can track which sales come from them.

transcript.speaker: Woman 2
transcript.text: Good idea. I'll ask the web team if they can set that up before the summer campaign starts.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Are you ready for the client presentation at two? I just tested the projector in Conference Room B.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Thanks. Did everything work?

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: The projector's fine, but the cable doesn't fit your new laptop.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Oh no. And the IT department is closed for lunch until one thirty.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Pedro in accounting has the same laptop as you.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Good thinking! I'll go and see if he has an adapter I can borrow.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Hello, this is Victor Haas. I have an appointment with Dr. Lin on Thursday at ten, but something urgent has come up at work. Could I reschedule?

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Of course, Mr. Haas. Dr. Lin has openings on Friday at eight thirty or next Monday at three.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Friday morning would be better. I'd like to get it done before the weekend.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: All right, you're booked for Friday at eight thirty. Please arrive ten minutes early so we can update your insurance information.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Will do. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Hi, I have a delivery for Greenleaf Market: twenty cases of sparkling water and ten cases of orange juice.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Hmm, we ordered twenty cases of juice, not ten. We're running a promotion this weekend.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Let me check the invoice... You're right, it says twenty. The rest must still be at our depot.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Can you bring the other ten before Saturday? The promotion starts at opening time.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: I'll call my dispatcher now. We have another truck coming to this area on Friday.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: As you know, we're moving to the new building on the fifteenth. Gareth, is the moving company confirmed?

transcript.speaker: Man 1
transcript.text: Yes. They'll come on Friday the fourteenth after five, so we won't lose a working day.

transcript.speaker: Man 2
transcript.text: What about the computers? Last time we moved, half of them weren't working on Monday morning.

transcript.speaker: Man 1
transcript.text: This time, the IT team will pack them up themselves and reconnect everything over the weekend.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Great. And everyone should label their boxes with their new desk number. I'll send out the floor plan this afternoon so people know where they'll be sitting.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Ahmed, the client just called. They want the website launch moved up by two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Two weeks? The design team is still finishing the product pages.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: I know, but they're starting a big advertising campaign and want the site to be live before it begins.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Well, the developers did say the checkout section went faster than planned.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: So you think it's possible?

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Maybe, if we postpone the blog section until after the launch. Let me talk to the team leads this afternoon, and I'll get back to you.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Hi, I reserved a compact car for three days under the name Petrov.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Yes, Mr. Petrov. I'm afraid all our compact cars have been rented out, but I can give you a midsize car at no extra charge.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: That's fine. Does it come with GPS? I'm not familiar with the area.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: It does. And here's a map showing the gas stations near the airport. The car needs to be returned with a full tank.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Understood. Is there a charge if I drop it off a few hours late on Sunday?

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: We allow a one-hour grace period. After that, we charge for an extra day.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Are you joining the charity run on Saturday? The company is sponsoring a team.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: I'd love to, but I hurt my knee playing tennis last week.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Well, they also need volunteers to hand out water to the runners.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: That I can do. Who should I contact?

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Talk to Yoshiko in HR. She's organizing everything, and she's sending T-shirts to all the participants tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Hi, I have an interview at two o'clock with Ms. Ferreira.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Welcome. Could you sign in here, please? Ms. Ferreira usually works in human resources, but that floor is being painted this week, so today she's interviewing candidates in the marketing department.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: OK. Should I take the stairs or the elevator?

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: The elevator is just behind you. And please wear this visitor badge while you're in the building.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm a little early. Is that a problem?

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Not at all. There's a waiting area right next to the elevator on that floor.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: We need to pick a day for the company picnic. The park is available any day this week except Sunday.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Let's check the forecast. Well, Friday's out, obviously.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: And Thursday is a workday for the warehouse team, so they couldn't come.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Then it'll have to be the cloudy day. At least it won't be too hot.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Agreed. I'll reserve the picnic area now and order sandwiches from Rosa's Deli later.

media.title: Quarterly Sales by Region (in thousands of dollars)

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: I've just finished the quarterly sales report. As usual, the South had the strongest results.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Yes, the new store there is doing great. But I'm more interested in the region with the lowest sales. That's where the extra marketing budget should go.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: I agree. Although, the East opened two new stores late in the quarter, so its numbers might improve on their own.

transcript.speaker: Woman
transcript.text: Hmm, that's a good point. In that case, let's give the extra budget to the second-lowest region instead, and review the East next quarter.

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.text: Sounds reasonable. I'll inform the regional manager this afternoon.

questions.prompt: What problem does the woman have?
options: She is late for a meeting.
questions.explanation: « I think I left my employee badge at home » : elle a oublié son badge.
questions.trap: Le permis de conduire sert seulement de pièce d'identité.

questions.prompt: What does the man ask the woman to do before she leaves?
questions.explanation: « Please return it to this desk before you leave. »
questions.trap: La voiture est évoquée, mais il ne lui demande pas de la déplacer.

questions.prompt: What does the man say about the parking garage?
options: The temporary pass will not open it.
questions.explanation: À la question « Will it open the parking garage too? », il répond « I'm afraid not » : le badge temporaire n'ouvre pas le parking.
questions.trap: Il faut relier « I'm afraid not » à la question précédente.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.explanation: La machine à café fuit pour la troisième fois : c'est un appareil défectueux (« faulty appliance »).
questions.trap: La salle de pause est seulement l'endroit où se trouve la machine.

questions.prompt: What does the woman say she has done?
questions.explanation: « I've already asked facilities to repair it twice. »
questions.trap: Le remplacement n'est qu'envisagé : rien n'a encore été acheté.

questions.prompt: What will the man do next?
questions.explanation: « I'll e-mail it to you right now » : il envoie le lien vers la publicité.
questions.trap: C'est la femme qui préparera la demande budgétaire.

questions.prompt: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explanation: « Let's look at the results of the spring campaign. »
questions.trap: Le site web est évoqué pour expliquer les ventes, pas pour être refondu.

questions.prompt: What does the second woman say about store sales?
questions.explanation: « sales in our stores didn't increase much ».
questions.trap: « double » concerne le nombre de vues des vidéos.

questions.prompt: What does the man suggest?
options: Including a discount code in videos
questions.explanation: « we should add a discount code to the next videos » pour mesurer les ventes qu'elles génèrent.
questions.trap: Aucune baisse de prix généralisée n'est proposée.

questions.prompt: What did the man just do?
questions.explanation: « I just tested the projector in Conference Room B. »
questions.trap: Le nouvel ordinateur appartient à la femme.

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, “Pedro in accounting has the same laptop as you”?
options: To ask Pedro to give the presentation
To explain why the laptop is broken
To suggest where to find an adapter
questions.explanation: Le service informatique étant fermé, il suggère que Pedro, qui a le même ordinateur, a sans doute l'adaptateur. Elle répond qu'elle va lui en emprunter un.
questions.trap: Ne pas exploiter la réaction de la femme, qui confirme l'intention (« Good thinking! … an adapter »).

questions.prompt: What will the woman do next?
questions.explanation: « I'll go and see if he has an adapter » : elle va voir Pedro, un collègue.
questions.trap: Le service informatique est fermé jusqu'à 13 h 30.

questions.prompt: Why is the man calling?
questions.explanation: « Could I reschedule? » : il veut déplacer son rendez-vous.
questions.trap: L'assurance n'est mentionnée qu'à la fin, pour une mise à jour.

questions.prompt: When will the man see the doctor?
questions.explanation: Il choisit le vendredi à 8 h 30.
questions.trap: Jeudi à 10 h est le rendez-vous annulé ; lundi 15 h était l'autre créneau proposé.

questions.prompt: Why is the man asked to arrive early?
questions.explanation: « Please arrive ten minutes early so we can update your insurance information. »
questions.trap: Ne retenir que « arrive early » sans écouter la raison qui suit.

questions.prompt: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explanation: Elle apporte une livraison, consulte la facture et parle de « my dispatcher » : elle est livreuse.
questions.trap: Le répartiteur (« dispatcher ») est la personne qu'elle va appeler.

questions.prompt: What problem does the man mention?
options: Part of an order is missing.
questions.explanation: Ils ont commandé 20 caisses de jus et n'en reçoivent que 10 : une partie de la commande manque.
questions.trap: La facture est juste (« it says twenty ») ; c'est la livraison qui est incomplète.

questions.prompt: What will the woman do next?
questions.explanation: « I'll call my dispatcher now » : elle contacte un collègue de son entreprise.
questions.trap: « dispatcher » est paraphrasé par « colleague ».

questions.prompt: What are the speakers preparing for?
questions.explanation: « we're moving to the new building on the fifteenth ».
questions.trap: Les ordinateurs sont seulement déplacés, pas remplacés.

questions.prompt: What problem happened during a previous move?
questions.explanation: « Last time we moved, half of them weren't working on Monday morning. »
questions.trap: « we won't lose a working day » concerne le déménagement à venir, pas le précédent.

questions.prompt: What will the woman send this afternoon?
options: A schedule for the IT team
questions.explanation: « I'll send out the floor plan this afternoon ».
questions.trap: Les employés étiquetteront eux-mêmes leurs cartons.

questions.prompt: What does the client want?
questions.explanation: « They want the website launch moved up by two weeks » : « move up » = avancer.
questions.trap: Comprendre « move up » comme « repousser ».

questions.prompt: Why does the man say, “the developers did say the checkout section went faster than planned”?
options: To suggest that the new deadline might be possible
To complain about the design team
To explain why costs have increased
questions.explanation: Le temps gagné sur le paiement en ligne rend l'avancement envisageable ; la femme le comprend ainsi (« So you think it's possible? »).
questions.trap: Prendre la remarque pour un simple compliment adressé aux développeurs.

questions.prompt: What will the man do this afternoon?
questions.explanation: « Let me talk to the team leads this afternoon. »
questions.trap: La section blog sera reportée, pas rédigée cet après-midi.

questions.prompt: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.explanation: Réservation d'une voiture, GPS, retour avec le plein : ils sont au comptoir d'un loueur.
questions.trap: Les stations-service sont mentionnées sur la carte, ce n'est pas le lieu de la scène.

questions.prompt: What does the woman offer the man?
options: A larger car at the same price
An extra day at no charge
questions.explanation: « I can give you a midsize car at no extra charge » : une voiture plus grande sans supplément.
questions.trap: Le GPS est déjà inclus dans le véhicule ; ce n'est pas une offre spéciale.

questions.prompt: What happens if the car is returned more than an hour late?
questions.explanation: « We allow a one-hour grace period. After that, we charge for an extra day. »
questions.trap: Le plein est exigé dans tous les cas, sans lien avec le retard.

questions.prompt: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.explanation: « Are you joining the charity run on Saturday? »
questions.trap: Le tennis explique seulement la blessure de l'homme.

questions.prompt: Why will the man not run?
questions.explanation: « I hurt my knee playing tennis last week » : il est blessé.
questions.trap: « hurt my knee » doit être reconnu sous la forme générale « injury ».

questions.prompt: What will the man probably do on Saturday?
questions.explanation: Il accepte de faire partie des bénévoles qui distribuent de l'eau (« That I can do »).
questions.trap: C'est Yoshiko qui organise et envoie les tee-shirts.

questions.prompt: Why is the man visiting the company?
questions.explanation: « I have an interview at two o'clock with Ms. Ferreira. »
questions.trap: Ce sont les peintres qui travaillent à l'étage des RH, pas l'homme.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which floor will the man go to?
questions.explanation: Aujourd'hui, Mme Ferreira reçoit au service marketing ; d'après le panneau, le marketing est au 4e étage.
questions.trap: Le 3e étage (ressources humaines) est son bureau habituel, mais il est en travaux.

questions.prompt: What does the woman give the man?
questions.explanation: « please wear this visitor badge while you're in the building ».
questions.trap: L'ascenseur est mentionné, mais aucune clé n'est remise.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers planning?
questions.explanation: « We need to pick a day for the company picnic. »
questions.trap: L'équipe de l'entrepôt est évoquée pour ses disponibilités.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. On which day will the event most likely take place?
questions.explanation: Vendredi (pluie) et jeudi (travail pour l'entrepôt) sont exclus, le parc est indisponible dimanche ; « the cloudy day » est samedi.
questions.trap: Dimanche est ensoleillé, mais le parc n'est pas disponible ce jour-là.

questions.prompt: What will the woman do first?
options: Reserve an area in a park
questions.explanation: « I'll reserve the picnic area now and order sandwiches … later » : la réservation vient en premier.
questions.trap: Les sandwichs seront commandés plus tard, pas récupérés maintenant.

questions.prompt: What did the man just finish?
questions.explanation: « I've just finished the quarterly sales report. »
questions.trap: Le budget marketing est discuté, mais il n'a rien demandé.

questions.prompt: What does the man say about the East region?
questions.explanation: « the East opened two new stores late in the quarter ».
questions.trap: Les meilleurs résultats sont ceux du Sud.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which region will receive the extra budget?
questions.explanation: Les ventes les plus faibles sont à l'Est (280), mais ils choisissent la deuxième plus faible : le Nord (320).
questions.trap: Choisir l'Est, la région aux ventes les plus faibles, sans tenir compte du changement de décision.
